_comment: THE IMPLEMENTATION-SOURCE REGISTER. One row per wrapper module, keyed
package/module. It answers the one question the catalogue cannot: which
Python library, or which paper, will implement this module.
THE STATES. Every row is seeded 'planned' with library and paper both
null. A row becomes 'selected' when it names EITHER a library pinned in
uv.lock OR a paper with an identifier, never both, and never neither.
The wrapper docstrings read their 'Reference implementation:' line from
here, so a row filled in is a docstring corrected on the next generation.
It is REBUILT from the sealed cards rather than edited alongside them,
so it cannot drift from the catalogue it describes.
